indications: CYKLX is indicated for ocular surface anesthesia prior to ocular procedures and/or intraocular injections in adults and pediatric patients.
contraindications: The recommended dose of CYKLX is 2 drops applied 30 seconds apart to the ocular surface.
warningsAndPrecautions:
CYKLX 8%, is supplied as an aseptically prepared, sterile, clear and colorless solution for topical ophthalmic use contained in a low-density polyethylene, single-dose vial with a 0.4 mL fill. 5 single-dose vials are packaged into a foil pouch, with 10 foil pouches in a carton.
                  NDC 87047-7852-01: Carton of 10 foil pouches, 50 single-dose vials.
adverseReactions: CYKLX is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity to any component of this preparation.
name: CYKLX
